items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Cobb was great, he didn't think that was Jimmy's fault.

ctx.x: ...not behaving themselves up to Wes's expectations, not the image that Wes wanted. Jimmy Cobb was great, he didn't think that was Jimmy's fault. He was complaining too with the trio. And Wes was saying, 'Man, you know, these guys are great players and all that, but...' He had missed me and Buddy, too. Now that he was back in it again, and he said...'Man, it looks
like it's all right now. I can afford it. The money's right and I can offer you guys a decent salary, and we'll be a unit, be back together again.'
